patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout with a large, bold heading on the left and a complex, multi-element graphic/mockup on the right, creating a dynamic visual balance.

Prominent use of a vibrant, multi-color palette (yellow, pink, green, blue) for decorative background shapes and accent elements, contrasting with a largely neutral (off-white, dark grey) content area.
Large, organic, overlapping colored shapes are used as distinctive decorative background elements, particularly in the hero and before the footer, injecting a playful and energetic visual break.

The primary navigation bar transitions from a transparent, slightly taller state in the hero to a sticky, slightly shorter state with a solid light background and a subtle shadow as the user scrolls down.
Large, bold, sans-serif headings with generous line height are paired with smaller, clean body text, maintaining strong hierarchy and readability.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is initially transparent and taller, then uses a scroll-triggered state change to become a sticky element with a solid light background, reduced height, and a subtle drop shadow as the user scrolls past the hero section.
Content sections are revealed as the user scrolls, appearing with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation effect as they enter the viewport.

Decorative background elements are created using large, overlapping, organically shaped blobs of vibrant color, positioned to frame content sections or act as visual anchors, adding a playful and modern aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body text) with a clean, legible body font. Subheadings are often uppercase and smaller than main headings but larger than body.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons, input fields, and some card elements (e.g., 4-8px).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within the hero, while content cards and lists maintain a tighter rhythm.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the playful and vibrant use of large, organic, overlapping colored shapes as decorative background elements. This injects a sense of energy and modernity into an otherwise corporate topic, effectively contrasting with the clean, structured content.
